title: alnaster sieboldianus
intro: Alnaster sieboldianus, commonly known as Japanese alder, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. The health benefits of Alnaster sieboldianus include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and reduce the risk of heart disease due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to exhibit anti-atherosclerotic and anti-hypertensive effects, as well as its potential to protect against liver damage. Alnaster sieboldianus contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
